originality.rationale: Classical stability, attractor, phase-portrait, bifurcation, and generalized-flux literature were checked. No accessible source states the affine-flux if-and-only-if classification of critical recurrent orbits or its invariant-measure rigidity; older inaccessible full texts remain explicit residual risks for the classical special case.

value.rationale: The result turns a nonhyperbolic energy equality case into an exact global recurrence classification, identifies the structural obstruction to critical decay, and closes the classical periodic KS global-stability threshold at equality.
